subject.title: fix(discord): disable ws 8.21.0 receiver part limits for gateway sockets

question: Should OpenClaw disable `ws` 8.21 retained-part limits for trusted Discord gateway sockets after the stale test assertion is repaired, or require finite Discord-specific limits before merge?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and the availability regression is credible, but setting both limits to `0` deliberately weakens dependency security hardening on a network socket, so the permanent resource-exhaustion posture needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Discord-only exemption
options.body: After the test assertion is repaired, merge the focused fix if maintainers agree Discord gateway traffic is trusted enough to restore pre-8.21 retained-part behavior only on these sockets.

options.title: Require finite Discord caps
options.body: Ask for high bounded `maxBufferedChunks` and `maxFragments` values if maintainers want to preserve a retained-part resource guard.

options.title: Pause for fuller product proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until a full OpenClaw Discord plugin run demonstrates after-fix stability through product wiring.

recommendation.title: Accept Discord-only exemption
recommendation.body: After the test assertion is repaired, merge the focused fix if maintainers agree Discord gateway traffic is trusted enough to restore pre-8.21 retained-part behavior only on these sockets.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR and has the strongest recent history on the affected monitored Discord gateway socket path.
